found.name: Academic integrity training
found.quote: the member of teaching staff will notify the student via email and will require the student to complete academic integrity training

found.name: Students’ Union representative
found.quote: the student may choose to bring a student colleague of the student’s choice or a Students’ Union representative (but not any other person or body unconnected with the University).

found.name: Academic Integrity Officer education role
found.quote: The Academic Integrity Officer is a central role responsible for educating staff and students on academic integrity, supporting Academic Integrity Advisors, and investigating cases of academic misconduct.
